name: Period Tracker
description: Personal menstrual cycle tracking: record period start and end dates, review history, and predict the next period from recent cycles.

dbPath.description: SQLite database file. Defaults to <OpenClaw state dir>/period-tracker/period.db so data survives plugin reinstalls.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone used to decide what 'today' is, e.g. Europe/London. Defaults to the host zone.

reminders.description: Suggest follow-up reminders after a period start is recorded. Defaults to true.
